title: FilingEnvelope
description: The payload edgar-fetcher POSTs to edgar-parser. Intentionally both the current wire format and the future queue-message format.

cik.description: As printed in EDGAR's daily index — may or may not be zero-padded to 10 digits.

accession_number.description: EDGAR's unique ID for the submission, e.g. "0001234567-26-000123".

form_type.description: e.g. "4" for a Form 4 insider transaction filing.

filed_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD, as printed in EDGAR's daily index.

fetched_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when edgar-fetcher retrieved the filing.
